texts.zh:
长期以来，我们认为[capital_star.GetName]是一颗典型红巨星，但近期分析显示，其体积和辐射排放持续增长，已对气候产生明显影响，导致人口日益恐慌。

当前趋势毫无停止迹象，为了我们物种的存续，必须查明这一现象的成因。
texts.en:
We have long thought of [capital_star.GetName] as a typical red giant, but recent analysis indicates that its size and radiation emissions are increasing. These changes are already having a measurable effect on our climate and the population is growing alarmed.

The trends show no sign of stopping. If our species is to survive, we must investigate the cause of this phenomenon.

notes.zh: 评注：红巨星起源的主线。游戏开始45天后（infernals.10 → 45）发出，并启动情势“红巨星膨胀”（五个阶段，进度走满则新星爆发，被逆转则恢复）以及事件链“红巨星”。四个选项选择最初的应对方式（对应情势的不同路线）。
notes.en: Commentary: the main line of the Red Giant origin. Fired 45 days after game start (infernals.10 -> 45), it starts the situation "Red Giant Expansion" (five stages; nova if the progress completes, restored if reversed) and the event chain "Red Giant". The four options choose the initial approach (different situation routes).

texts.zh: 恒星辐射的快速变化威胁着母星的稳定。若继续如此，[Owner.Capital.GetStarName]终将发生新星爆发，粉碎整个恒星系。
texts.en: The rapid changes in our star's emissions threaten the stability of our homeworld. If this continues, [Owner.Capital.GetStarName] will eventually go nova, atomizing the system.

notes.zh: 应对方针取决于阶段所设旗标（approach1–4）；“不惜一切代价”仅在阶段4–5可选。
notes.en: The available approaches depend on stage flags (approach1-4); At Any Cost is only available in stages 4-5 (common/situations/13_infernal_situations.txt:171-429).

texts.zh:
这个文明正站在命运的十字路口：其恒星系中央的红巨星正在持续升温，炙烤着他们的家园。

在找到原因并解决之前，他们是否能适应这恶劣的环境？或选择拥抱这股炙热之力，将那诡异、甚至可能不自然的变化化为己用？
texts.en:
This civilization is at a crossroads: the Red Giant at the heart of its system is warming up their planet, threatening to cook them alive.

Can they adapt until the cause is found and fixed, or will they decide to embrace the heat, capitalizing on these strange and perhaps unnatural changes?

title.zh: 三角定位亚空间干扰源

texts.zh: 用于三角定位干扰源的可行地点。
texts.en: Viable location to triangulate the origin of interference.

texts.zh: 在全力逆转恒星变化的同时，我们自身必须做好面对高温的准备。适应更高温度将助我们在这炽热的新未来中繁荣。
texts.en: As we work tirelessly to reverse our star's changes, our own forms must be prepared to face the heat. Adapting our population to higher temperatures will help us thrive alongside our star's fiery new future.

texts.zh: 辐射增强虽带来长期挑战，但短期内可提升工业与能源产能。
texts.en: Increased solar radiation presents serious long term problems, but in the short term, we can harness it to boost our industrial and energy capacity.

texts.zh: 这群鲁莽的外星人正利用我们的恒星，必须立即登陆夺取控制权。
texts.en: These reckless aliens are exploiting our star. We must board their station immediately and take control.

texts.zh: 开采站的居民控制着正在摧毁我们恒星的亚空间虹吸装置。我们必须建立沟通，确保他们配合解决此问题。
texts.en: The station's inhabitants control the subspace siphon that is destroying our star. We must establish communications to ensure their cooperation in solving this issue.

summary.text:
# 令人担忧的趋势 / Concerning Trends

> 本文为人工审阅导读（评注），不是游戏原文；原文见阅读器。 / Reviewer guide (commentary), not original game text; the original text is in the reader.

- 分类 Category：C8 银河轶事 / Galactic miscellany
- 来源 Sources：`events/infernals_1_events.txt:120-140,751-1110`; `events/infernals_1_events.txt:1640-1990`; `events/infernals_1_events.txt:4476-4780,5500-5700`; `common/situations/13_infernal_situations.txt:1-260`
- DLC：Infernals Species Pack
- 审阅 Reviewed：2026-10-13（已审阅 reviewed）

## 如何开始 How it starts

“红巨星”起源（origin_red_giant）：游戏开始45天后 infernals.10 → infernals.45 弹出，并同时启动情势 situation_red_giant_expansion 和事件链 red_giant_event_chain。

The Red Giant origin (origin_red_giant): 45 days after game start infernals.10 -> infernals.45 fires, starting the situation situation_red_giant_expansion and the event chain red_giant_event_chain.

## 剧情脉络 Story outline

情势共五个阶段（进度300/600/900/1200/1500）：第2阶段 infernals.65（保护母星或利用热能的专项二选一）、第3阶段 70、第4阶段 75、第5阶段 80（无窗口）；进度走满为新星（50 → 24个月后 51）；若被逆转则 60（恢复常态）。第2阶段起，每月有概率触发 infernals.95“恒星隧道”，开启专项“三角定位亚空间干扰源”：在三个地点依次出现 105、110、115，最后一个发现卢瑟斯采矿站所在的陌生星系，那里有守卫无人机——击毁它们引出 2151“神秘的采矿站”：翻译语言（专项 → 2125 谈判）或强攻（专项 → 2115 登船）或直接摧毁（2121/2122）。谈判、登船的各选项导向 2130/2131/2135 等“亚空间采矿作业”，24个月后 2140“稳定前景”，再到 2145“稳定达成”，最后 2160“危机火花”。

The situation has five stages (progress 300/600/900/1200/1500): stage 2 infernals.65 (a choice of two projects: protect the homeworld or exploit the heat), stage 3 infernals.70, stage 4 75, stage 5 80 (no window); full progress is the nova (50 -> 51 after 24 months); if reversed, 60 (back to normal). From stage 2 there is a monthly chance of infernals.95 "Stellar Tunnels", opening the project "Triangulate the subspace interference": 105, 110 and 115 appear at three locations in turn, the last revealing the unknown system of the Lusus mining station, guarded by drones — destroying them brings 2151 "A Mysterious Station": translate (project -> 2125 negotiations), board by force (project -> 2115) or destroy it (2121/2122). The options of negotiation and boarding lead to the "Subspace Mining Operation" events 2130/2131/2135, 24 months later 2140 "Prospect of Stability", then 2145 "Stability Achieved" and finally 2160 "A Spark of Crisis".

## 分支与结局 Branches and outcomes

新星 / 恢复；保护母星 / 利用热能（65）；谈判时的五个选项（庇护、给船让他们离开、奴役、远程排空、让他们自行判断）和登船后的七个选项（摧毁、审讯、奴役、清除、对话、净化、吃掉）；稳定星体时的三种命运（固定现状、加速膨胀、恢复常态，2140）。

Nova / restored; protect the homeworld / exploit the heat (65); five options in negotiation (sanctuary, give them a ship, enslave, vent remotely, let them judge) and seven after boarding (demolish, interrogate, enslave, eliminate, speak, purge, eat); three fates when stabilising the star (fix it, accelerate it, return to normal; 2140).

## 条件与文明差异 Conditions and variants

选项依伦理、政体和起源而异（如奴役需允许奴隶制，吃掉仅限掠食类）；65 的正文有商团版本。

Options depend on ethics, government and origin (enslaving needs slavery to be allowed, eating is for predators only); the text of 65 has a megacorp version.

## 审阅记录 Review notes

核对了情势定义、各阶段事件、三角定位、采矿站与摧毁分支；原先的 event-infernals-10（含宇宙黎明部分）、event-infernals-2150、event-infernals-2120 并为本故事，宇宙黎明另立 event-infernals-2500。该起源属 C1，若 C1 另建起源家族应删除本家族。

Checked the situation definition, the stage events, the triangulation, the mining station and the destruction branches; the former event-infernals-10 (which also contained the Cosmic Dawn part), event-infernals-2150 and event-infernals-2120 are merged here, Cosmic Dawn becomes event-infernals-2500. The origin belongs to C1: drop this family if C1 builds an origin family.
